rationale: TLK is an Indonesian ADR where 73% of the day's total change occurred overnight in the local market, leaving a compressed $0.39 intraday range with 5-minute ATR at just $0.025 ($0.01 bid-ask spread represents 40% of a 5-minute bar's range). With 1-minute volume drying up into single-cent prints right below session highs, the friction costs and lack of intraday volatility offer poor risk-reward in either direction.
